Description

NeuroHire is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Python Developer to design, develop, test, and maintain software applications using Python. This entry-level opportunity is ideal for recent graduates with a strong foundation in programming, software development, data structures, and backend technologies.

The selected candidate will collaborate with software engineers, product teams, and other technical professionals to build scalable applications, develop APIs, troubleshoot issues, and contribute to software development projects.

Key Responsibilities

Develop, test, and maintain applications using Python.

Write clean, efficient, reusable, and well-documented code.

Build and maintain RESTful APIs and backend services.

Work with databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, or MongoDB.

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and implement software solutions.

Debug applications, identify technical issues, and implement fixes.

Participate in code reviews and follow software development best practices.

Integrate third-party APIs, libraries, and external services.

Write unit tests and support application testing and debugging.

Assist with application deployment, maintenance, and performance optimization.

Use Git and version control systems to manage source code.

Requirements

Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

0–1 year of experience in Python development or software engineering.

Strong understanding of Python programming fundamentals, object-oriented programming (OOP), and data structures.

Familiarity with Python frameworks such as Django, Flask, or FastAPI.

Understanding of REST APIs, HTTP methods, and backend development concepts.

Basic knowledge of SQL databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.

Familiarity with Git, GitHub, and version control systems.

Understanding of software development principles, debugging, and testing.

Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.

Good written and verbal communication skills.

Ability to work independently and collaborate with technical teams.

Preferred Qualifications

Academic projects, internships, or hands-on experience in Python development.

Familiarity with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, or CI/CD pipelines.

Basic understanding of Linux and command-line tools.

Familiarity with data processing libraries such as NumPy and Pandas.

Exposure to AI/ML libraries such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, or Scikit-learn.

Understanding of Agile development methodologies.

Benefits

Opportunity to work on real-world software development projects.

Hands-on exposure to Python, backend development, and API integration.

Collaborative environment with experienced software development professionals.

Opportunities to strengthen programming, technical, and problem-solving skills.

Professional development and long-term career growth opportunities.

Apply for this job
